lines.en: : You’ve just signed your death certificate, Sensei.

lines.en: scene toukakiss26
: Oh, Touka! And Sensei. Welcome home! Do either of you want the rest of my chocolate bar? I couldn’t finish all of it...

lines.en: : A deal’s a deal, Jessica. Besides, I think Yasu would want to be there for your first time.

lines.en: : She is here now. Shall we begin again?
lines.zh: : 她现在就在这儿。要不我们重新开始？

lines.en: : Something seems different...Touka’s very red...and her blood is moving very- ah! You did it!
lines.zh: : 好像有点不一样……Touka 好红……而且她的血流得好——啊！你们做了！

lines.en: : You did things! Things that weren’t done under the supervision of the Lord!
lines.zh: : 你们做了「事」！没在主监督下做的事！

lines.en: : Leave.
lines.zh: : 出去。
